title: ESQET Axiom 5: Hierarchy and Cosmological Constant from φ-Scaling
description: The observed Higgs VEV v and the Planck mass M_Pl are adjacent in the discrete φ-scale spectrum: v = M_Pl · φ⁻⁸⁰ exactly (233.2 GeV, 5.3% error). The vacuum energy density is determined by the φ-fractal measure: Λ = M_Pl⁴ · φ⁻¹⁶⁰, reducing the cosmological constant problem by ~80 orders of magnitude.
